context: Two coworkers discuss a security plan for an event broadcast live
purpose: Teach: 警備/中継/看護/録画/残す/時には/次第に/観る

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今度の生中継のイベント、会場の警備はどうする予定ですか？
lines.en: For the upcoming live broadcast event, what's the plan for venue security?
lines.style: Polite workplace tone, raising a planning concern early.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 正面ゲートに警備員を増やして、看護師も二名待機してもらう予定です。
lines.en: We'll add more guards at the front gate and have two nurses on standby.
lines.style: Calm, structured reply listing concrete arrangements clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なるほど。中継中に何かあったら、後で確認できるように全部録画しておきましょう。
lines.en: I see. If anything happens during the broadcast, let's record everything for later review.
lines.style: Thoughtful agreement, proposing a backup measure casually.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうですね。映像は最低三ヶ月は記録として残すように指示しておきます。
lines.en: Right. I'll instruct them to keep the footage on record for at least three months.
lines.style: Professional follow-through, confirming retention policy concisely.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 時にはお客さんが興奮して前に押し寄せることもあるので、油断は禁物ですね。
lines.en: Sometimes guests get excited and surge forward, so we can't let our guard down.
lines.style: Reflective warning drawn from past event experience.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、開演が近づくと次第に人が増えてくるので、入場制限も検討しています。
lines.en: Yes, as showtime approaches the crowd gradually grows, so we're considering entry limits.
lines.style: Steady delivery acknowledging crowd dynamics, suggesting controls.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かります。当日は私もスタッフルームのモニターで現場を観るようにします。
lines.en: That helps. On the day, I'll also watch the venue from the staff room monitor.
lines.style: Cooperative closer, committing personal oversight to the operation.
